records.title: Simmons University Kotzen Scholarship
records.deadline_display: Applicants must complete and submit their Simmons Distinguished Scholar essay and their admission application to the University by December 1.

source.raw_extract:
## Application Deadline

Applicants must complete and submit their Simmons Distinguished Scholar essay and their admission application to the University by December 1.

Finalists for scholarship consideration will be notified by the end of January and will be required to complete an interview in February. Recipients will be notified by March 1.
source.exact_deadline_wording: Applicants must complete and submit their Simmons Distinguished Scholar essay and their admission application to the University by December 1.
source.notes: Sharded official_source_url https://www.simmons.edu/undergraduate-admission/kotzen-scholarship returned HTTP 404. The legacy shortlink https://www.simmons.edu/kotzen now serves the current official Simmons scholarship page 'Simmons Distinguished Scholar Award' (https://www.simmons.edu/admission-aid/financial-aid/scholarships/simmons-distinguished-scholar-award), which is the top merit award that 'supersedes any previous merit scholarship' and is therefore the current official home of the Kotzen program. Identity caveat: Simmons itself now uses the name 'Simmons Distinguished Scholar Award'; the Kotzen name survives only on the legacy shortlink and in the undergraduate catalogue. No year is printed next to the deadline on the official page, so no YYYY-MM-DD can be formed without inventing one; recorded as recurring annual December 1 rather than a calendar date. Deadline wording gives a day (the 1st) plus month but no year, so MONTH ('source gives a month or window, no day') does not apply either; recurring annual precision is the accurate label.

records.deadline_display: The scholarships are administered by the Danish universities, who each select the students, who are awarded with a scholarship. For further information about the government scholarship, please consult the admission details of the higher education institution of your choice.

source.publisher: Danish Ministry of Science, Higher Education and Digital Affairs (studyindenmark.dk)
source.raw_extract:
## **Danish government scholarships for highly qualified non-EU/EEA students**

Danish universities receive a limited number of government scholarships each year to fund highly qualified full-degree students from non-EU/EEA countries and Switzerland.

[...]

The scholarships are administered by the Danish universities, who each select the students, who are awarded with a scholarship.

For further information about the government scholarship, please consult the admission details of the higher education institution of your choice.

***Please note:*** The government scholarship consists of two parts and can be given as full or partial tuition fee waivers and/or grants towards covering your living costs. However, since the scholarships are administered by the higher education institutions themselves, you should enquire at the institution of your choice for further details.
source.exact_deadline_wording: The scholarships are administered by the Danish universities, who each select the students, who are awarded with a scholarship. For further information about the government scholarship, please consult the admission details of the higher education institution of your choice.
source.notes: Verified against the live official ministry page: the ministry publishes NO application deadline of its own for this award. It explicitly delegates the deadline to each individual university's admissions process ('consult the admission details of the higher education institution of your choice'). There is therefore no single official deadline value for this record. Per brief section 5 an individual university's admissions deadline is NOT admissible evidence for this record (another institution's deadline cannot stand in for the ministry award), and no single university was designated in the shard, so no date could be recovered. This is not ROLLING - the source never says rolling or no fixed deadline; it simply does not state one. Not CONFLICTING either, since that requires two credible sources disagreeing about the SAME deadline; here no source states a deadline at all. UNKNOWN is the truthful result and is confirmed, not guessed: the absence of a ministry deadline is itself directly evidenced by the fetched page.

field_mapping.deadline_display: No ministry-published deadline. The Danish Ministry states: 'The scholarships are administered by the Danish universities, who each select the students, who are awarded with a scholarship. For further information about the government scholarship, please consult the admission details of the higher education institution of your choice.' The deadline is therefore set by each individual university and differs per institution.

rejected_sources.reason: programme finder only; the ministry itself directs applicants to individual institutions, and the shard designates no specific university whose deadline could be used

records.title: GETFund Postgraduate Foreign Scholarship (Ghana Education Trust Fund)
records.deadline_display: Applications for the scholarship opened on 13th April 2026 and will close on 30th April 2026.

source.publisher: Ghana Education Trust Fund (GETFund), Government of Ghana
source.raw_extract:
GETFund Opens Applications for 2026/2027 Postgraduate Foreign Scholarships
April 14, 2026

The Ghana Education Trust Fund (GETFund) has officially announced the opening of applications for its Postgraduate Foreign Scholarship Programme for the 2026/2027 academic year. [...]

Applications for the scholarship opened on 13th April 2026 and will close on 30th April 2026. Prospective applicants are required to complete the application process within this period through the official GETFund scholarship portal.
source.exact_deadline_wording: Applications for the scholarship opened on 13th April 2026 and will close on 30th April 2026.
source.notes: The official GETFund page is a JavaScript single-page application, so a plain fetch returns only the page title and no article body; the article text quoted here was obtained by actually loading and rendering the live page in a browser and reading document.body.innerText on 2026-10-05. It states an explicit calendar closing date of 2026-04-30 for the 2026/2027 postgraduate foreign scholarship round. That date is over five months in the past relative to retrieval while the record is carried as active/upcoming, so per brief section 6 the stale date is NOT written and NOT silently moved to the 2027/2028 round. semantics is EXACT because the source does state an explicit calendar deadline; deadline_date stays null because the value is expired. The same live site carries a newer item, 'GETFund Opens Applications for 2026/27 Undergraduate and Postgraduate Local Scholarships' (dated Oct 2, 2026), but that is a DIFFERENT scheme (local, not foreign) and per brief section 6 different programmes are not a conflict and its deadline was not imported into this record. A human should confirm the record's cycle before any date is written.
